title: A gate filing in a managed repository binds that repository's own E2E case
description: Runs the real batch gate over a managed repository whose catalog holds one case: a test check and the catalog case both fail as known reds, and each filing binds a case that repository can hold — the failing case itself, or a new case named like the pinning proof — so create's E2E rule accepts it there.

steps.name: known reds the gate files in a managed repository pass create's E2E rule
